title: Nine Lines and One Tuesday
subtitle: 戏剧与影视 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧与影视（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧与影视（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：actor　|　正文 318 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 actor 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 an ① actor came to the hall and forgot nine lines in the first scene, and my grandmother said that was the honest part. The ② actor, meaning the man and not the part, was fifty-four and had played the same role eleven times; an actor, she said, is somebody who is paid to be somebody else in public. She said the being paid was the strange half of it.

Every ③ actor in that company had another job, and she said that was the whole of the theatre. Their ④ actor who forgot came back on the Tuesday and did it perfectly; an actor, my father said, is the only worker who is judged twice, once for the rehearsal and once for the night. He said the night is the one everybody remembers.

My uncle said he had been ⑤ an actor in the whole business, meaning a participant and not a performer, and my mother said he had been neither. The ⑥ actor, meaning the profession and not the man, is nine parts memory and one part nerve; an actor, she said, is the only worker whose mistakes are visible to everybody and forgiven by nobody. She said that is why they drink.

By 1972 the ⑦ actor had taken to arriving nine minutes late and leaving before the applause. The ⑧ actor on the poster was younger by eleven years and better-looking; an actor, my father said, is either a person or a picture, and the poster is the one people believe. He said the poster was painted in 1961.

The ⑨ actor I remember is the one who forgot the nine lines and came back on the Tuesday. An ⑩ actor, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only person who is praised for being convincing and distrusted for it; every actor, she said, is a liar who has agreed to tell the truth. She said the agreement is the whole art.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 演员；男演员（一个人）
B. n. 演员（指人本身，与角色相对）
C. n. 演员（指忘词又回来那一位）
D. n. 参与者；作用者（比喻义）
E. n. 演员（指这个职业、这门行当）
F. n. 演员（泛指这类人）
G. n. 演员（指海报上那一位）
H. n. 演员（抽象总称）

items.q: an actor came to the hall
The actor, meaning the man and not the part
an actor in the whole business
the actor had taken to arriving nine minutes late
An actor, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: actor 意为“演员”，1968 年有一位演员来到礼堂，第一场就忘了九句台词，祖母说那才是诚实的部分。
actor 指“人本身”，与角色相对，那位演员五十四岁，同一个角色已经演过十一次。
actor 泛指“演员这类人”，那个剧团里每一位演员都另有工作，她说这就是戏剧的全部。
actor 意为“演员”，他们那位忘词的演员星期二回来，演得完美无缺。
actor 为比喻义，意为“参与者、起作用的人”，叔叔说他在整件事里是个参与者而不是表演者。
actor 指“这个职业、这门行当”，与人相对，是九分记性加一分胆量。
actor 意为“演员”，到 1972 年那位演员养成了迟到九分钟、掌声未起就先走的习惯。
actor 指海报上那一位，海报上的那位演员年轻十一岁，也更好看。
actor 指忘词又回来那一位，我记得的是那位忘掉九句台词、星期二又回来的演员。
actor 为抽象总称，祖母说演员是唯一因为可信而受称赞、又因可信而不被信任的人。
